verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents role-based access control ('Assigning roles to members') and scoped API access tokens ('API access tokens'), directly matching the story's request for roles, permissions, and scoped tokens to restrict who can change flags. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of custom role granularity and confirmation of per-token flag/project scoping restrictions in practice, and no community corroboration of this specific governance feature.
